name: claude-clan
description: Turn your codebase and GitHub PRs into a live isometric city where AI agents visibly build and review your software in real time.

paragraphs: Turn a codebase into an isometric city, then run it as the mayor: type a command, a Claude agent crew picks it up, and the city reacts live — cranes rise over files being edited, buildings grow with the code, and a sessions list keeps every concurrent conversation visible.

As agents take on more of the actual building, the bottleneck shifts from writing code to keeping track of what an agent is doing — which files it's touching, where the work is concentrating, when to step in. A terminal transcript or a PR diff doesn't show that at a glance. Claude City turns the repo into a spatial map instead, so watching a Claude agent build or review code feels like watching a construction site, not scrolling a log.
features: Districts are directories, sized by a treemap over lines of code.
Buildings are files, colored by language.
Streets and traffic are derived from import edges between files.
The crew is one or more Claude Agent SDK sessions, driven by mayor
